name: project-checks
title: 프로젝트 검사 — 린트·정적 분석
use: Lint / static analysis of a target repo (checkstyle, PMD, ruff, mypy, eslint, tsc, go vet, clippy) for the arch map.
rules: The target repo path is given in the request text. Do not edit, commit, checkout or install anything in the target repo; do not install tools. The runner writes only under ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/<HEAD>/checks.json (same store key as arch-map). Metadata only: never copy tool messages or source text into a report.

stages.title: 검사 실행
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_checks.py --repo <repo>` once from this repository (it detects only the tools the repo itself declares / configures — never default rules — runs each with a timeout and writes checks.json). Report its printed line only. Do not rerun with other options, do not run any tool yourself, do not fix findings.
